name: Shadow Totem, Greater (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Barbarian 12, shadow totem rage power

Benefit: While raging, the barbarian gains the see in darkness ability, allowing her to see perfectly to any distance in darkness, including magical darkness. She is immune to blindness while raging. In addition, the Strength damage she deals on critical hits from her lesser shadow totem increases to 1d6.
